blocks.cap: Hundreds of job seekers connect with recruiters at Robinsons Malls’ Job Fair, exploring diverse career opportunities across industries.

blocks.html: Recognizing the vital role of Filipino workers in nation-building, Robinsons Land Corporation (RLC), through its Commercial Centers Division, Robinsons Malls, once again leads the charge in promoting economic empowerment through its expansive Nationwide Job Fair.

Happening in multiple mall locations across the country, the initiative is organized in collaboration with the Department of Labor and Employment (DOLE) and local Public Employment Service Offices (PESO). The initiative will connect thousands of job seekers with opportunities in both the private and public sectors, opening meaningful pathways to career growth and long-term financial stability.

This year’s Labor Day Job Fair series began in late April with successful legs in Robinsons Magnolia, and Robinsons Cagayan de Oro last April 24, followed by activations in Robinsons Ilocos (April 25), Robinsons Tugegarao (April 28), Robinsons General Trias and Robinsons Malolos (April 30).

Job seekers can expect simultaneous Labor Day events on May 1 at key Robinsons Malls locations nationwide, including Robinsons Manila, Robinsons Galleria, Robinsons Las Piñas, Robinsons Metro East, Robinsons La Union, Robinsons Pangasinan, Robinsons Santiago, Robinsons Naga, Robinsons Palawan, Robinsons Galleria Cebu, Robinsons Iloilo, Robinsons Butuan, and Robinsons Pagadian.
Additional job fairs are also scheduled on May 2, including Robinsons Antipolo, and Robinsons Lipa, ensuring broader access for job seekers across regions.

blocks.cap: From resumes to real opportunities, job seekers take the next step at Robinsons Malls’ Job Fair.

blocks.html: Participating employers will offer opportunities across various industries including retail, services, logistics, agriculture, manufacturing, public service sectors, and more — giving applicants access to diverse career pathways in one accessible venue.

Select Robinsons Malls will also have on-site government services allowing applicants to complete key employment requirements in one convenient location. Participating agencies include PhilHealth, Social Security System (SSS), National Bureau of Investigation (NBI), Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR), among others.

The job fairs are part of Robinsons Malls’ broader mission through its Lingkod Pinoy Center, which serves as a one-stop hub for government services, livelihood support, and career development initiatives nationwide. Beyond Labor Day, Robinsons Malls will continue to roll out job fairs throughout the year, reinforcing its commitment to economic empowerment and community development.

Job seekers are encouraged to come prepared, bring multiple copies of their resumes, and take advantage of on-the-spot application and hiring opportunities. For updates on schedules, participating companies, and application requirements, follow Robinsons Malls on its official social media pages or visit www.robinsonsmalls.com.
